$comment: A row's second line, a group's footer and the disclosure row of the native toolkit (#915). Taken from the current Settings, which is the spec: .nidara-row-subtitle and .nidara-list-footer in ui/lib/nidara-kit/styles/_components.scss, and the disclosure of ui/shell/surfaces/settings/PreferencePage.ts. Final values require owner live review.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; variants override whole fields like list.json. Exported once as rows in each components.json mode variant.

footer.source: .nidara-list-footer: font-size $fse-caption, color var(--nidara-text-dim), margin-top 8px (mirroring the header's margin-bottom).

disclosure.source: PreferencePage.ts: Gtk.Image pixel_size 16, uiIcon nd-pan-down when revealed, nd-pan-end when not; revealed at first (reveal_child: true).
